figures.shows: A top view of a root joint's path in the clip, from a start facing plus Z to a later place and heading, and the same travel in the world applied to an entity that faces plus X, turning the travel with the entity
figures.caption: The clip measures the travel in the frame the root faced at the start, and the entity turns that travel into its own frame before it moves.
figures.alt: Two panels seen from above. In the left panel a curved path starts at a dot facing down the page and ends at a second dot with its arrow turned to the right; a dashed arrow joins the two dots. In the right panel an entity faces right, and a dashed arrow of the same length points up and to the right, ending at a dot with a turned arrow.
